definitions.explanation: A set of rules governing conduct, or the state of controlled behavior according to such rules. Also refers to self-discipline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軍隊|ぐんたい}→軍隊：02678_guntai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{規律|きりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Strict discipline is required in the military.

examples.japanese: {規律|きりつ}⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{規律|きりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れている→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧。
examples.english: The organization's discipline is falling apart.
